description: This file defines the WordsSplitter class, which provides functionality to generate possible word splits based on key codes, particularly handling space key proximity and permutations for word segmentation in an input method editor.

classes.name: WordsSplitter
classes.description: Main class responsible for splitting words based on key codes and space proximity, supporting permutation-based splitting logic.

classes.name: WordsSplitter.Result
classes.description: Inner class managing the collection of possible split results, iterable over different split permutations.

classes.name: WordsSplitter.ResultRow
classes.description: Inner class representing a single row of split options, iterable over sub-words.

classes.name: WordsSplitter.WrappingKeysProvider
classes.description: Inner class implementing KeyCodesProvider, wrapping a segment of the original key codes for splitting.

methods.name: WordsSplitter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pool of WrappingKeysProvider objects and the result container.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Generates all possible word splits based on key proximity and permutations, returning an iterable of split options.

methods.name: addSplitToList
methods.description: Creates a split segment and adds it to the current permutation row.

methods.name: hasSpaceInCodes
methods.description: Checks if the last code in an array of nearby key codes is a space.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a segment of key codes for splitting.
